text:
Bitcoin broke past the $64,000 threshold on Tuesday, July 7, trading near $64,072 as a major institutional recovery takes shape. Following last week’s $221.7 million net inflow, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs registered another $266 million in net inflows on Monday, July 6, confirming structural re-entry. Despite this positive momentum, flows remain split as BlackRock’s IBIT extended its net outflow streak to 11 days, offset by strong buying in Fidelity's FBTC.

On the macro front, the U.S. Dollar Index (DXY) consolidated near 100.90, while the 10-year Treasury yield rose slightly to 4.51% as bond markets await Wednesday’s FOMC minutes. Globally, regulatory progress accelerated with Ripple securing a full MiCA license in the EU and Bitcoin Suisse gaining license approval in Abu Dhabi, building a stronger regulatory floor for institutional participation heading into Q3.
